description: Add a Note to a Workspace: a few words of your own beside its Panels. Formatted text only, shown in Banquish's own style: "# Heading" (or "## Smaller heading"), paragraphs, "- " or "1. " list items, and [links](https://…); anything else, HTML included, shows as the text it is. No bold or italic: write plain words (** is dropped). At most 2000 characters. Placement is where its Tile goes on the grid, as in arrange; without one it goes full width below the last Tile. With h, a Note's Tile is that tall, even taller than its text. The user can undo it with the rest of your Working stretch. Returns the Fit report: at the user's window, which Tiles are scaled below their Panel's minimum width, scroll inside, fell back to crop, are broken or ambiguous, or leave their Tile's width unused, and any gaps between Tiles; and, not as an issue, which Panels are shorter than the h of their Tile, so show centred in it. A Tile whose page hasn't laid it out at its width yet (one not on screen, say) is settling: a later report says how it fits. While a settling Tile's minimum width isn't known, whether the Workspace shows as one column isn't either: oneColumn is left out, and the summary says so.
name: add_note
title: Add a Note
